name: trit-only
meaning: one balanced trit per element; the bit channel does not exist

name: independent-dual
meaning: two independent channels per element: one bit and one trit
notes: the only case where Dual6 is information-optimal

name: exact-dual
meaning: two expansions of one integer N: base-2 and balanced-base-3
write_semantics: recompute the middle symbol block for N
notes: redundant by design; pays for zero-conversion dual reads

name: shadow-projection
meaning: one trit plus a derived bit, e.g. b = (t != 0)
notes: the second channel carries no new information; not recommended
